lineages.hypothesis: Industry groups that did better over the half year that ended a month before a month starts do better than the other groups in that month, so the monthly rank correlation across groups is positive on average. A pass would only keep the sector tilt in shadow and put the result on file for the shadow path (CTX-053); nothing trades.

panel.months: the first session of each calendar month, on the series' own session list
panel.needs: at least 147 sessions before the month start (126 for the signal and 21 for the gap) and 21 after it, decided from the session list alone
panel.groups: a group counts in a month when its series has a row on the month start session and a row on or before the first signal session; it is left out when it has fewer than 3 members on the month start session
panel.month_floor: at least 4 groups left in the month; at least 95 such months before any signal or outcome is read

series.function: sectorSeries (S1): equal-weight, integer ppm, chained from 1,000,000, a member that moves more than 60 percent in one session is left out
series.sessions: every session of the extract calendar
series.members: the U1 codes of the session by the app tier rule over the bars up to and including it; closes are the vendor split-adjusted closes, no dividends
series.classification: the current ASX industry group of the extract's listed-company file for every date (static industry); a code with no group or with the group Not Applic is left out

signal: the group's level ratio from the session 147 before the month start to the session 21 before it (the 126 sessions that end 21 sessions before the month start)
outcome: the group's level ratio from the month start session to the session 21 after it, minus the mean over the groups of the month
statistic: mean over months of the Spearman rank correlation of signal and outcome across the month's groups; a month with a constant signal or outcome is left out and counted
look: one look over the full window, because the months after 2021 are far fewer than the blocks the effect size needs
report_only: the mean for the months that start on or after 2022-01-01 and for the months before; neither is a gate
pass: at least 95 months with a defined correlation and the one-sided 90 percent lower bound of the mean above 0
null: floors met and the lower bound not above 0
inconclusive: fewer than 95 qualifying months, or no history: no look is spent; a statistic that cannot be computed after the floor: look spent
afterLook: no re-run, no re-tuning, no second look
